summary.text: The painting path is the Gu path of painting path dao marks, portraits, ink, and related killer moves.

claims.text: The novel treats painting path as a scarce named cultivation path with its own dao marks and Immortal methods, not as ordinary art skill.

In Crazed Demon Cave, Fang Yuan sees a carpet-like patch of dao marks whose surface lights form mountains, rivers, birds, and animals, and that can attach lightly onto foreign dao marks without crumbling. He takes them for painting path dao marks. He also notes that immortal materials made from gathered painting path dao marks would be reference for creating the corresponding path.

After raising many attainments from dream realms, Fang Yuan still has painting path blank. Spectral Soul’s dream realms lack it, and Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable kept painting path in his own hands without letting information leak, even more secretive than Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck path inheritance.
After exhausting dream realms, Fang Yuan again lists painting path among paths that remain completely blank, and names it as intentionally concealed by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable.

Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable cultivated wood path as the primary, with painting path as his specialty. Inside Divine Emperor City, Genesis Lotus’ will activates painting path killer moves Scenic Portrait, ink slicing thread, and brush stroke against Fang Yuan’s portrait, wounding Fang Yuan’s body with ink injuries that reverse flow protection seal fails to stop because Fang Yuan’s painting path attainment is blank. Fang Yuan had gathered some painting path mortal Gu, but they are far out of depth against that level of painting path method.
After the Crazed Demon Cave battle, Fang Yuan counts Transient White Cloud City Suppression painting path formation among Heavenly Court methods he now understands.
